campus: YOUR CAMPUS NAME (EcoVision Mini AI Campus Sorting Rules)

recyclable.guidance: Empty and rinse it, then put it in the campus recycling bin.
recyclable.caution: Greasy or wet items may not qualify.

organic.caution: Check that no packaging or plastic stickers are mixed in.

hazardous.guidance: Do not put it in general waste. Hand it over at the designated e-waste / battery collection point (batteries, mercury/CFL tubes, and electronics).
hazardous.caution: Safety note: batteries, fluorescent/CFL tubes (mercury), and electronics are hazardous. (Note: incandescent, halogen, and LED bulbs are non-hazardous general trash).

general.guidance: Put it in the regular non-hazardous general waste (trash) bin.
general.caution: Could it be reused or reduced next time?

unsure.guidance: Not sure. Take a clearer photo of one item or ask campus staff (check local rule).
unsure.caution: The system is not sure. Do not guess.
